title: Module review
subtitle: Everything about the northern Rhône
objectives: Describe the northern Rhône's landscape and grapes

steps.prompt: Match each appellation to its wine.
steps.explanation: Each appellation has its own style.

steps.prompt: How much Viognier may be co-fermented in Côte-Rôtie?
steps.explanation: Up to 20%, though most use much less.

steps.prompt: Grenache is a main grape of the northern Rhône.
steps.explanation: Not true. Syrah is the only red grape there.
The north is steep, not flat.
For its sun-baked, south-east facing slopes.

steps.title: What you learned
points: The northern Rhône is steep, granite and continental
Syrah is its only red; Viognier, Marsanne and Roussanne its whites
Côte-Rôtie and Hermitage are its great wines
Syrah here suits lamb, game and pepper
